title: AI School @ AI Institute
desc: Build AI agents, integration engines and AI-native products. Python + one LLM API + Jupyter — signal over infrastructure.
subtitle: AI agents, integration engines and AI-native product design
intro: A builder-focused program inspired by the "learn by building" approach. The frontier has moved from model improvements to AI agents, integration engines and intelligent systems that work inside real products and workflows — and that is what we build.

modules.title: Development of Integration Engine
modules.desc: The plumbing that connects LLMs to real tools and data sources.

modules.title: Content Transformation
modules.desc: Turn dry, technical input into short, useful, human-sounding messages — the cohort's flagship project.

modules.title: Metrics & Behavioral Framework
modules.desc: How to evaluate an agent. If it sounds synthetic, it fails — quantify that signal.

modules.title: AI-Native Product Design
modules.desc: Designing products that feel native to the AI substrate, not bolted-on chatbots.

modules.title: Prompt Engineering
modules.desc: System and user prompts that hold up under production stress.

modules.title: AI Product Management & Development
modules.desc: The end-to-end lifecycle: scoping, building, evaluating, iterating.

modules.title: Interview Preparation
modules.desc: Mock interviews, system design and offer negotiation for AI roles.

outcomes: Ship working AI agents end-to-end with a minimal stack
Design evaluation systems that catch synthetic output
Engineer prompts that behave consistently in production
Combine your work with the AI & Web3 Startup Incubator
audience: AI engineers moving from research to product
Product builders adding LLM capability to real workflows
Founders and CTOs of early-stage AI startups
Strong technical people who want to ship, not just lecture

instructors.name: Timur Bakibayev, PhD
instructors.bio: PhD in Computer Science (Heidelberg University). Founder of a stealth EdTech startup.

instructors.name: AI Practitioner
instructors.bio: Builder and product lead with shipped AI-native systems.

faqs.a: Intentionally minimal: Python + one LLM API (Claude / OpenAI / Gemini — your choice) with Jupyter as the execution layer. No infrastructure abstraction; just building and iterating.

Build a Content Transformation Agent that turns a dry technical AI update into a short, human-sounding message that makes the reader want to reply "Show me!". You submit architecture, prompts, a real example and a short screencast.

faqs.q: Can I combine this with the Startup Incubator?
faqs.a: Yes — AI School participants can also take part in the AI & Web3 Startup Incubator and turn their work into a real product.
For the strongest submissions, API tokens are provided for the selected LLM providers.
